spans.s:
m. (-कः)
A lover, a gallant.
E.
रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. वुन्, and र changed to ल.

m. (-टः)
1 A lecher, a libertine, a whore-monger, a gallant.
2 The Bakula tree.

f. (-ता)
Libertinism, dissoluteness.
E.
लम्पट, and तल् aff.; also लम्पटत्वं.

m. (-कः)
1 A country, the district of Lamghan in

Cabul.
2
A libertine, a lecher.

m. (-हः)
A kettle drum, a state drum, the Nakāra of the Muselmans.

mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं)
1 Spacious, capacious.
2 Great, large, broad, long, expanded either in breadth or length, or both.
3 Pendulous, depending.
m. (-म्बं)
1 A bribe, a present.
2 Moving a man at a sort of backgammon or draughts.
3 A perpendicular, (in geometry.)
4 (In astronomy,) The arc between the pole and zenith of any place.
f. (-म्बा)
1 A name of LAKṢMĪ.
2 A name of GAURĪ or

DURGĀ.
3

A bitter gourd.
E.
लबि to fall, to sound, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
1 A section, a chapter.
2 A perpendicular, &c.
E.
लवि to fall, वुन् aff.

m. (-र्णः)
1 A goat.
2 An elephant.
3 A goblin or Rākṣasa.
4 A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.)
5 A hare.
6 A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
लम्ब large or pendulous, and कर्ण the ear.

f. (-ज्या)
Sine or cosine of the latitude.
E.
लम्ब, and ज्या sine.

n. (-नं)
1 Depending, descending, falling.
2 A long necklace, one which depends from the neck to the navel.
m. (-नः)
Phlegm, the phlegmatic humour.
E.
लबि to fall, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Depending, descending, hanging or falling, going down.
2 Being large or bulky.
E.
लबि to fall, &c., and शानच् aff., मुक् augment.

f. (-का)
The uvula or soft palate.
E.
लबि to hang down, aff. क्वुन् fem. form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Suspended, depending, falling or hanging down.
E.
लबि to fall down, aff. क्त.

f. (-षा)
A necklace of seven strings.
E.
लबि to depend, उषच् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of GAṆ

EŚA.
2

A glutton.
E.
लम्ब large, and उदर the belly.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A camel.
E.
लम्ब large, and ओष्ठ a lip.

n. (-नं)
1 Abuse, reviling.
2 Gaining, getting.
E.
लभि to sound, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Causing to get, procuring, producing.
E.
लभ to get, causal v., शतृ aff.

f. (-म्भा)
A sort of chain enclosure or fence.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Caused to get, given to, procured for.
2 Applied to, employed, adapted.
3 Spoken to, addressed.
4 Heightened, improved, rendered more perfect or intense.
5

Cherished.
6

Gained.
7

Abused.
E.
लभ to gain, causal form, or लभि to revile, क्त aff.

n. (-कं)
The root of the Andropogon muricatum, a fragrant grass.
E.
ला what takes or removes (heat, &c.), मज्जा the pith, and कप् added.
